items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1959-08-11
items.q: When Johnny St. Cyr said Balto used to play with John sometimes

ctx.x: Mm-hmm. When Johnny St. Cyr said Balto used to play with John sometimes and violinists. Oh, yeah, Valto.
Valto. Oh, yeah. He was a good violin player. A Creole fellow, Valto. Yeah, he was good. Who was, he was one of the very best?
